Description: Infection through contact with infectious individuals in community, hospital, or during funerals; rate = (beta_I * S * I + beta_H * S * H + beta_F * S * F) / N
End of incubation period, becoming symptomatic and infectious; rate = alpha * E
Hospitalization of infectious cases; rate = c_h * h_1 * I
Death of non-hospitalized cases in the community; rate = c_d * (1 - h_1) * d_1 * I
Death of hospitalized cases; rate = c_dh * d_2 * H

Name: beta_I
Description: Transmission coefficient in the community

Name: beta_H
Description: Transmission coefficient at the hospital

Name: beta_F
Description: Transmission coefficient during funerals

Name: alpha
Description: Inverse of the mean duration of the incubation period

Name: 1/c_h
Description: Mean duration from symptom onset to hospitalization

Name: 1/c_d
Description: Mean duration from symptom onset to death

Name: 1/c_i
Description: Mean duration of the infectious period for survivors (onset to end of infectiousness)

Name: 1/c_f
Description: Mean duration from death to traditional burial

Name: h
Description: Proportion of cases hospitalized

Name: d
Description: Case-fatality ratio

Name: h_1
Description: Computed parameter so that h% of infectious cases are hospitalized

Name: d_1
Description: Computed death probability for non-hospitalized infectious cases to achieve overall CFR d

Name: d_2
Description: Computed death probability for hospitalized cases to achieve overall CFR d

Name: N
Description: Size of the population

Name: R_0
Description: Basic reproduction number

Name: R_0I
Description: Community component of R_0

Name: R_0H
Description: Hospitalization component of R_0

Name: R_0F
Description: Traditional burial component of R_0

Name: 1-z
Description: Decrease in community transmission after interventions
